content: Ligand 1 carries the anilide NH and QED 0.875; what it lacks is the NH-azine link, since its para substituent is a pyrazolyl biaryl which I have now measured three times at only 0.03-0.07. Ligand 2 has the higher QED but a stereocentre and SA 2.80, so it is the worse host. Atom 13 is the aromatic carbon bearing the pyrazole at atom 14 over a non-ring biaryl bond, so I cut it and attach pyridin-2-ylamino - monocyclic azine, ring nitrogen ortho to the bridging NH, donor hydrogen free. That is the single highest-value edit available on this molecule.
